item.title: Chestnut and Law streets to be closed Tuesday for water main repair
item.description: Press Release Please be advised that Chestnut Street and Law Street in the City of Batavia will be closed on Tuesday, Dec. 23 for the repair of a water main.Motorists should seek an alternate route to minimize traffic congestion.We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your cooperation.

item.title: TableTop Art Show returns in March with call for artists, sponsors and host sites
item.description: 2024 file photo by Howard Owens Press release:The TableTop Art Show returns in March 2026, transforming participating restaurants, breweries and businesses across Western New York into a month-long community art experience—bringing artwork off gallery walls and onto tabletops where the community gathers.Organizers are now accepting artist submissions through Monday, Feb. 2, 2026 (midnight)
